chunk_text: Dogs require balanced nutrition with proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals. Puppies need high-protein diets (22-32% protein) for growth.
Adult dogs need 18-25% protein. Feed twice daily for adults, three times for puppies. Always provide fresh water.
Dogs should receive regular vaccinations including rabies, DHPP (distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, parainfluenza). Annual check-ups recommended.
Always store medications in original labeled containers. Never give human medications to dogs. Common safe medications: amoxicillin, aspirin (with vet approval).
Toxic substances: acetaminophen, ibuprofen, chocolate, grapes, onions. If accidental exposure, contact vet immediately.
Cats are obligate carnivores needing high-quality protein (30%+ for adults). Kittens need 30-40% protein. Feed 2-3 times daily for kittens, once daily for adults.
Ensure adequate taurine intake (essential amino acid). Wet food helps maintain hydration.
Cats need FVRCP vaccine (feline viral rhinotracheitis, calicivirus, panleukopenia) and rabies. Dental care crucial - brush teeth regularly.
Rabbits need unlimited timothy hay (80% of diet), fresh vegetables (leafy greens), and limited pellets. Provide 1 cup pellets per 5 lbs body weight daily.
Avoid: iceberg lettuce, beans, grains. Hay keeps teeth healthy and aids digestion.
Birds need varied diet: high-quality pellets (60%), fresh fruits/vegetables (30%), seeds/nuts (10%). Avoid: avocado, chocolate, salt, caffeine.
Horses need unlimited hay/pasture (1.5-2.5% body weight daily), supplemented with grain/concentrates based on activity level. Working horses need more calories.
